S01.name: Registry/exchange/legal identities
S01.trigger: `corporate.identity_change`, `security.listing`, or evidenced ownership change when an authoritative dated record establishes it; match registry/LEI/security ID plus action.
S01.qualification: First import is a baseline, not an IPO; LEI/name updates do not prove ownership. Reviewed internal edits are decisions, not independent external corroboration.
S01.routing_intent: Product/commercial, financial; identity support for all layers.

S02.name: EODHD inventory/profiles/fundamentals
S02.trigger: Nominate `security.listing`, `corporate.identity_change` or `corporate.financial_disclosure` from a new security or material reported field; resolve security/company and source period.
S02.qualification: Snapshot differences require original dated evidence; provider omissions do not prove delisting and current profiles cannot establish historical changes.

S03.name: EODHD prices/volume/actions
S03.trigger: Splits/dividends can establish `security.corporate_action` keyed by security, action ID/type and effective date. An optional causal threshold rule can create `market.anomaly` for a price/volume excursion.
S03.qualification: Daily bars remain features. An anomaly is an observed market movement, not an explanation; use a prior-data threshold and retain action-adjustment provenance.
S03.routing_intent: Financial/market; prices also feed HMM/TFT directly.

S04.name: HKEX cross-listed prices
S04.trigger: Corroborate security/action events; optionally nominate `market.cross_listing_dislocation` from synchronized, currency-normalized prices under a versioned rule.
S04.qualification: Routine prices are features. Align sessions, FX, share ratios and security types; stale quotes do not establish arbitrage or a corporate development.

S05.name: Benchmark/index/ETF prices and FX
S05.trigger: Optional `market.regime_observation` or `market.fx_shock` when a causal, predefined threshold is crossed, keyed by instrument and interval.
S05.qualification: Keep ordinary observations as features; do not call an HMM state change an external news event or infer its cause from returns.

S06.name: ETF holdings/constituent history
S06.trigger: `market.constituent_change` or `market.holdings_disclosure` from a published rebalance/holdings edition; key fund/index, security and edition/action.
S06.qualification: Newly captured current holdings do not prove the trade date or historic membership; weights can change with prices without trading.

S07.name: SEC EDGAR filings/exhibits
S07.trigger: Extract financing, results, leadership, transaction, risk or other typed developments; key accession plus claim locator, then correlate the underlying action across filings/PR.
S07.qualification: A filing is evidence, not automatically one event. Amendments revise evidence or establish a separately disclosed milestone; filing publication and transaction effective dates differ.
S07.routing_intent: Financial, leadership, product/commercial and applicable domain layers.

S08.name: SEC XBRL/company facts/notes
S08.trigger: `corporate.financial_disclosure` or `corporate.restatement` from a filed period/metric package and accession; link original notes for context.
S08.qualification: Do not create an event per XBRL cell or treat later restated values as originally available. Companyfacts without notes cannot support note-specific claims.

S09.name: HKEXnews announcements/documents
S09.trigger: Extract earnings, placements, connected transactions, leadership changes or listing milestones using issuer/document ID and action context.
S09.qualification: Consolidate language copies and derivative document captures; one announcement can contain several events. Retrieval date is not announcement date.

S10.name: CNINFO/EDINET/local filings
S10.trigger: Extract typed financial, capital, governance or transaction disclosures; key authority/document/issuer and action.
S10.qualification: EDINET observations do not establish CNINFO coverage. Preserve local document types, language and publication times; cross-listed copies share provenance.

S11.name: Original company/customer/lender/utility/supplier websites
S11.trigger: `product.launch`, `commercial.contract`, `operations.change` or financing/partnership milestone from explicit original announcements; key parties, asset and stage.
S11.qualification: Changed HTML, catalogs and undated marketing only nominate candidates. Partner/customer statements may corroborate one deal rather than create another.

S12.name: Optional private-funding provider
S12.trigger: Nominate `corporate.financing`, acquisition or leadership events using provider transaction identity and dated underlying reporting.
S12.qualification: Deferred optional acquisition is not an enabled route. Require licensed capture and evidence; provider enrichment is not independent corroboration of its cited announcement.

S13.name: Finlight news
S13.trigger: Extract the reported development into its typed event; use `news.material_claim` for a new specific claim lacking another type. Correlate original article/provenance, parties and action.
S13.qualification: Feed arrival and repeated coverage are not new occurrences; retain reported/disputed status and whether full text or only snippets was captured.
S13.routing_intent: Route by claim to applicable specialists.

S14.name: Marketaux news
S14.trigger: Same typed extraction as Finlight; identify original publisher/article and match the development across both aggregators.
S14.qualification: Two aggregators carrying one article are one reporting lineage; sentiment metadata alone does not establish a business event.
S14.routing_intent: Route by claim; financial/market for reported market context.

S15.name: Personnel/news RSS and derived archive
S15.trigger: `personnel.appointment`, `personnel.departure`, `personnel.role_change` or evidenced workforce action; match person, organization, role and dated change.
S15.qualification: Personnel archive is a derivative view of parent sources, not another independent witness. Keywords, job openings and biographies do not prove movements.
S15.routing_intent: Leadership/workforce, operations where exposure is evidenced.

S16.name: Licensed analyst estimates/coverage
S16.trigger: `market.analyst_revision` or `market.coverage_change` when a named analyst/broker changes a dated estimate, rating or coverage status; retain fiscal period/horizon.
S16.qualification: Requires licensed point-in-time vintages. Consensus changes from contributor composition differ from an analyst revision; latest estimates cannot be backdated.

S17.name: ClinicalTrials.gov
S17.trigger: `clinical.registration`, `clinical.status_change`, `clinical.protocol_change`, `clinical.results` from trial IDs and versioned fields/results; link attachments.
S17.qualification: Registry posting is not necessarily trial start or first patient. Differentiate sponsor-reported dates from public version availability; changed recruitment is not automatic efficacy evidence.

S18.name: EMA CTIS
S18.trigger: Trial authorization/decision, status or protocol disclosure from public trial/decision IDs and versioned evidence.
S18.qualification: Application, decision, start and publication are separate milestones. Public visibility or metadata changes alone do not establish approval or results.

S19.name: FDA/openFDA actions/public CRLs
S19.trigger: `regulatory.decision`, `regulatory.safety_notice` or a typed action from identifiable official records; extract a CRL outcome only from retained public evidence.
S19.qualification: Map the actual endpoint/action; not every openFDA record is an approval. Private or absent CRLs cannot be inferred, nor can counts establish causation.

S20.name: Drugs@FDA reviews/labels/packages
S20.trigger: Approval, supplemental indication, label revision or newly disclosed review findings; key application, submission, action and document version.
S20.qualification: A package supports several claims but is not several approvals. Later review-package publication can enrich an earlier decision only from its own availability time.

S21.name: EMA medicines/EPAR/labels
S21.trigger: Authorization, variation, indication, withdrawal or published assessment findings keyed by medicine/procedure/decision.
S21.qualification: Separate committee opinion from final authorization; current medicine metadata is not a complete history. Parent metadata and downloaded EPAR share provenance.

S22.name: MHRA designations/decisions
S22.trigger: `regulatory.designation` or explicit authorization/decision from named product, scheme, jurisdiction and official notice.
S22.qualification: ILAP/orphan designation is not marketing authorization. A changed current list nominates a change unless dated supporting evidence establishes it.

S23.name: PMDA designations/reviews
S23.trigger: Designation, review/opinion or explicit decision from official product/procedure evidence.
S23.qualification: Keep PMDA review separate from an authorization issued by the relevant authority. List removal or translation differences alone do not establish withdrawal.

S24.name: Health Canada NOC/decisions/labels
S24.trigger: Authorization, conditional authorization, indication or label change from submission/NOC/product identifiers.
S24.qualification: Preserve decision type and conditions; market authorization does not imply reimbursement or commercial launch.

S25.name: ChiCTR
S25.trigger: Trial registration, recruitment/protocol change or disclosed results from trial identity and saved versions.
S25.qualification: Current records cannot reconstruct all prior revisions. Registration dates do not prove availability of later fields or trial success.

S26.name: NMPA trial inventory/details
S26.trigger: Trial registration and explicit status/protocol/results disclosures keyed by registry trial ID and version.
S26.qualification: Inventory adds discovery candidates; initial inventory is a baseline, and disappearance is not cancellation. Clinical registration is not drug approval.

S27.name: PubMed metadata
S27.trigger: `research.paper_published`, correction or retraction keyed by PMID/DOI and publication notice; nominate domain claims if captured abstract supports them.
S27.qualification: Indexing time differs from publication and availability. Metadata does not establish full-text results; reuse S28 linkage to avoid counting the same paper twice.

S28.name: Europe PMC/full text/supplements
S28.trigger: Paper/preprint publication, correction/retraction or supported result disclosure keyed by DOI/PMCID/version and claim.
S28.qualification: Metadata, full text and supplements are evidence for the same contribution, not independent replication. Article retrieval today does not establish when every passage was public.

S29.name: Crossref proceedings
S29.trigger: `research.paper_published` or `research.abstract_published` when contribution metadata establishes its type and publication; key DOI.
S29.qualification: Proceedings metadata does not prove a talk occurred or an entire conference was newly announced. Deposit/update dates differ from publication; unknown availability stays unknown.

S30.name: Original conference/society material
S30.trigger: Conference announcement, abstract release, evidenced presentation, poster results or speaker disclosure; key meeting edition + contribution/session + milestone.
S30.qualification: Agenda listing proves a scheduled talk, not delivery/results. Link program, poster and paper without collapsing distinct release milestones or duplicating the scientific claim.
S30.routing_intent: Scientific/clinical, IP/technology; leadership/conflict context when relevant.

S31.name: NICE guidance
S31.trigger: `policy.guidance_change` from consultation, draft, final recommendation or update keyed by guidance ID, version and stage.
S31.qualification: Do not treat draft recommendations as adopted guidance or guidance as a drug authorization; scope population, intervention and conditions.

S32.name: CMS coverage database/documents
S32.trigger: `policy.coverage_change` from proposed/final national or local determinations and revisions; key policy ID, jurisdiction/version/stage.
S32.qualification: Discovery catalog and downloaded policy document support one development. Publication and effective dates differ; document acquisition must precede text-specific claims.

S33.name: Society guidelines/payer policies
S33.trigger: Guideline recommendation, inclusion/removal or reimbursement restriction from identifiable policy edition and population/product scope.
S33.qualification: Requires retained original policy and revision evidence. Specialty recommendation and payer coverage are separate decisions, even when medically related.

S34.name: CMS Open Payments/author disclosures
S34.trigger: `disclosure.payment_publication` or `disclosure.interest_change` only from actual payment/disclosure records; key recipient/payer/record/reporting edition.
S34.qualification: Catalog editions alone establish dataset release, not a payment or conflict. Payment is not proof of bias; retain corrections and reporting-period/publication distinction.
S34.routing_intent: Scientific evidence/conflict assessment, leadership; financial only where justified.

S35.name: FDA inspections/compliance/enforcement
S35.trigger: `regulatory.inspection_finding`, `regulatory.enforcement`, `regulatory.import_refusal` or recall from facility/action/record and scope.
S35.qualification: Inspection classification, citation, compliance action and recall can be related but distinct. Product-code dictionaries are classification support; they cannot establish a new clearance or violation.

S36.name: NIH/funder awards
S36.trigger: `research.funding_award`, amendment or termination from project/award ID, fiscal action, organization and announced amount.
S36.qualification: Separate award action from multiyear total, disbursement and project start. Topic matches/PI affiliations require entity review; a grant does not validate the science.

S37.name: Hospitals/universities/labs/societies
S37.trigger: Research result, collaboration, leadership move, facility opening or trial-site milestone from explicit institutional announcements.
S37.qualification: Affiliation pages and directories support identities; they do not prove company ownership or a collaboration. Reposted university/company PR shares origin.

S38.name: Google Patents BigQuery
S38.trigger: Publication/grant or explicitly supported legal milestone from authority/publication/kind identity; connect family and technical claims.
S38.qualification: An added database row is not necessarily a recent publication. Family members remain distinct documents; CPC/current assignee changes do not establish dated ownership transfers.

S39.name: USPTO ODP applications/prosecution
S39.trigger: Publication or explicit status milestone, `patent.office_action`, and `patent.petition_decision`; key application + official action/decision document ID and milestone.
S39.qualification: See prosecution detail below. Application identity alone is not a document key. Rejections and petition outcomes do not establish product failure, final abandonment or grant.
S39.routing_intent: IP/technology; regulatory/legal risk and product/commercial relevance where evidenced.

S40.name: USPTO assignments/ownership evidence
S40.trigger: `patent.assignment` from recorded instrument identity, affected applications/patents, parties and execution/recordation dates.
S40.qualification: Multiple patent rows for one instrument can support one scoped transfer event. Applicant, reported assignee and current owner are different assertions; recordation does not prove an uninterrupted ownership chain.

S41.name: SAM.gov opportunities
S41.trigger: `procurement.opportunity`, amendment, cancellation or evidenced award notice keyed by notice/solicitation and version/stage.
S41.qualification: An opportunity is potential demand, not a won contract. Require bidder/awardee evidence before routing as a company win; amended deadlines are updates unless a separate action is material.

S42.name: TED procurement
S42.trigger: Opportunity, award, modification or cancellation from notice/procedure/lot/stage identifiers and original notice content.
S42.qualification: Avoid counting procedure and lot totals twice. Search metadata alone may not establish supplier/value; use original notice fields/documents before those claims.

S43.name: USAspending awards
S43.trigger: `procurement.award_action` or grant/funding action from award + transaction/action ID, amount and recipient.
S43.qualification: Obligation, outlay, ceiling and cumulative award total are different. Amendments can be positive or negative; repeating a cumulative total is not another award.

S44.name: Greenhouse jobs
S44.trigger: `workforce.posting_opened`, materially changed or explicitly closed posting from employer/job ID and captured versions.
S44.qualification: Job openings indicate recruiting intent, not a hire. First crawl is a baseline; disappearance requires completed comparable captures and a declared closure rule, otherwise unknown.
S44.routing_intent: Leadership/workforce, operations; specialist inference stays labeled.

S45.name: Lever jobs
S45.trigger: Same posting lifecycle events keyed by employer/posting ID; link roles/locations and changes supported by retained text.
S45.qualification: Do not duplicate cross-posted Greenhouse/Lever vacancies or infer workforce reductions from a missing page. Posting counts remain observed recruiting features.

S46.name: GitHub/vendor SDK/API docs
S46.trigger: `technology.release`, deprecation, compatibility or integration change from repository release/tag or documented vendor revision.
S46.qualification: Tag alone is not a commercial launch; mutable tags/docs need content hashes. Verify repo/product ownership and distinguish changelog announcement from installed adoption.

S47.name: NIST/test methods/independent tests
S47.trigger: `technology.test_method_release` or `technology.test_result` from dated method edition or retained test report and tested configuration.
S47.qualification: A discovery page is context until a document is captured. General methods do not establish device performance; customer/vendor tests are not automatically independent.

S48.name: MLCommons/MLPerf results
S48.trigger: `technology.benchmark_result` for a published submission/result release; key suite/version, division, workload, system/configuration and submission ID.
S48.qualification: Aggregate result rows as one scoped submission milestone where appropriate. Compare like workloads/rules; updated files are revisions, and benchmark rank is not customer adoption.

S49.name: Datasheets/tests/warranty/service/deployment evidence
S49.trigger: Product specification revision, test result, service notice, deployment or warranty change from asset/document/version and explicit action.
S49.qualification: Separate measured performance from vendor claims and warranty conditions. A revised PDF hash only nominates a material change; a specification is not proof of deployed performance.

S50.name: CPSC/product safety authorities
S50.trigger: `product.recall`, safety warning or remedy update from authority recall ID, product scope and action.
S50.qualification: S35/S50 or company notices can corroborate the same recall. Preserve hazard and affected units as reported; distinguish a recall from an adverse-event report.

S51.name: Federal Register/local rulemaking
S51.trigger: `policy.rule_proposed`, `policy.rule_finalized`, consultation or effective-date change keyed by authority/document/docket and stage.
S51.qualification: A proposed rule is not in force; effective date and publication differ. Route by evidenced jurisdiction and product/sector scope, not all companies indiscriminately.

S52.name: Trade-control/screening lists
S52.trigger: `policy.trade_restriction_change` from an authoritative listing/amendment/removal notice or a verified versioned list delta for a resolved entity.
S52.qualification: Current screening matches are context/candidates, not historical sanctions events. Preserve list authority, scope and identity uncertainty; the event pipeline does not supply legal interpretation.

S53.name: USGS minerals
S53.trigger: `macro.statistics_release` or report revision with new production/reserve/supply statistics; key series/report edition, commodity, geography and reference period.
S53.qualification: Statistics are measured estimates, not a company supply disruption. Extract units, vintages and revisions; unchanged archive discovery creates no event.
S53.routing_intent: Operations/supply chain, financial, energy-storage technology context.

S54.name: UN Comtrade
S54.trigger: `macro.trade_release` or versioned revision for a declared reporter/partner/commodity/flow/period bundle. Optional causal anomaly rules create `macro.trade_anomaly`.
S54.qualification: Routine trade rows remain features; don't generate a business event per cell. Commodity classifications, currency/quantity and reporting lag matter; absent data is not zero trade.

S55.name: DOE storage reports/models
S55.trigger: `research.report_published` or `technology.cost_assessment` from a dated report/model edition with newly disclosed cost/performance assumptions.
S55.qualification: Landing-page discovery alone is context. Modeled costs are scenario estimates, not observed vendor costs or a funding award; retain document version and assumptions.

S56.name: EIA generator inventories/electricity series
S56.trigger: `energy.capacity_disclosure` for a supported plant/generator status/capacity change; `macro.statistics_release` for a series edition. Key plant/generator or series/period/vintage.
S56.qualification: Archive index/workbook are one provenance chain. First inventory is baseline; planned, operating and retired status differ, and source release time is not commissioning time. Routine prices stay features.

S57.name: CAISO OASIS prices
S57.trigger: Routine intervals feed market context. Optional `energy.price_anomaly` when a versioned causal rule detects a node/market/interval excursion.
S57.qualification: No event per price tick; preserve market, node, timezone and revisions. A high price does not itself prove an outage, shortage or storage revenue opportunity.

S58.name: Utility/operator queues/tariffs/permits/projects
S58.trigger: `energy.project_milestone`, `policy.tariff_change`, permit decision, interconnection action or contract from project/queue/docket ID and stage.
S58.qualification: Queue entry is not construction or operation. Withdrawn/missing records need explicit evidence or a qualified observed-delta state; project ownership requires dated links.

S59.name: BLS labor series
S59.trigger: `macro.statistics_release` and revisions for a defined series/period/vintage; optionally a causal labor-cost anomaly.
S59.qualification: Series observations are context, not proof of company wage changes or hiring. Retain seasonal adjustment, units, release vintage and publication lag.

S60.name: SEMI reports/data
S60.trigger: `industry.report_published` or a supported capacity/shipments/forecast disclosure from licensed report edition and metric/period scope.
S60.qualification: Planned/licensed scope is not captured evidence. Industry forecasts remain forecasts; do not attribute an aggregate change to a specific manufacturer without evidence.

S61.name: IFR robotics statistics
S61.trigger: `industry.report_published` with installation/adoption statistics by declared geography/sector/period and edition.
S61.qualification: Annual releases do not establish daily robot deployments; revisions retain vintages. Aggregate installations cannot establish a particular vendor's sales.

S62.name: Licensed teardowns/commodity/cost feeds
S62.trigger: `technology.teardown_published`, component assessment or licensed cost/utilization report; key asset/report/edition, or an optional causal commodity anomaly.
S62.qualification: Respect acquired scope. Estimates differ from audited costs; routine assessments stay features, and teardown evidence does not prove IP infringement or sourcing for every unit.

S63.name: Reddit posts/comments
S63.trigger: `social.discussion_signal` for an explicit original report or a versioned, deduplicated activity threshold; underlying business allegations remain unverified candidates.
S63.qualification: Do not create accepted corporate events from rumor or infer causation from sentiment. Bots, reposts, edits and deleted content require provenance and coverage masks.
S63.routing_intent: Financial/market attention; domain specialists receive explicitly unverified claims.

S64.name: Bluesky public search
S64.trigger: Same qualified discussion/original-report candidates as S63 using stable post/author identities and captured versions.
S64.qualification: Only consumed if captured access exists. Search failure is not silence; repeated links to news enrich provenance rather than count as independent reporting.

S65.name: DataForSEO history/trends/SERP
S65.trigger: `attention.search_change` only under a predefined causal threshold or evidenced search-position milestone keyed by query, locale, device, interval and capture/vintage.
S65.qualification: Most observations remain attention features. Query-panel changes and provider revisions are not demand events; keyword history is not historical live-SERP evidence.

S66.name: Optional Google Trends
S66.trigger: Qualified `attention.search_change` from a fixed query/geography/window and versioned normalization/threshold policy.
S66.qualification: Relative, sampled scores vary by request window. Do not merge incompatible scales or infer absolute sales; optional integration must exist before dispatch.

S67.name: Optional private operational/patient/customer data
S67.trigger: `operations.milestone`, trial-site activation/recruitment milestone or aggregate adoption change from authorized versioned records and declared thresholds.
S67.qualification: Only authorized scoped access; keep restricted data and identifiable patient/customer details out of public event releases. Publish permitted aggregate claims with access-controlled evidence, or retain a separate restricted event catalog.
S67.routing_intent: Scientific/clinical, operations, product/commercial; scoped by access entitlement.

S68.name: ROR institution identities
S68.trigger: Identity/affiliation support; a dated authoritative rename/merge record can nominate `organization.identity_change` keyed by ROR ID and action.
S68.qualification: Current organization names/relationships cannot establish past affiliation, a research partnership, company ownership or a scientific milestone. Routine directory refreshes create no business event.
S68.routing_intent: Identity resolution for scientific/clinical and IP/technology.

isolation: Local files only. S3 GET-only sampling; no production writes, timers, provider calls or model scoring.
